scoreBasis: The shared PC and mobile PWA gate weights total 100. Passed gates total 99; one point remains for a manual assistive-technology check.
included: Anonymous use without sign-in or payment
Synthetic US and Japan fixtures for education and product-flow verification
Twelve method explainers, comparisons, reports, local save, backup, restore, delete, export, print, share and PWA offline shell
Public support, status, privacy notice and free-use conditions
excluded: Real security recommendations or return forecasts
Licensed live or end-of-day market data
Production identity, account sync and Google sign-in
Payment, refunds, tax and paid-service contracts
Personalized investment advice, orders or automated trading

gates.label: Free scope and no-payment boundary
gates.evidence: Release boundary and every public caution separate the free education build from commercial operation.

gates.label: Scan and per-method report flow
gates.evidence: Deterministic scan, pagination, report, errors and browser journeys are tested.

gates.label: Twelve method education records
gates.evidence: Plain explanation, principle, masters, case, source and caution are validated for all twelve methods.

gates.label: Family-balanced comparison and sensitivity
gates.evidence: Weight total, three-family rule and leave-one-out sensitivity are tested.

gates.label: Device-local watchlist and saved scans
gates.evidence: Bounded local state and lossless unknown-field preservation are tested.

gates.label: Local backup, restore and delete
gates.evidence: Version, boundary, size and integrity checks fail before mutation; delete is explicitly confirmed.

gates.label: JSON, CSV, print and share
gates.evidence: Exports, spreadsheet-injection protection, printing and sharing are available.

gates.label: Terms, privacy, support and status
gates.evidence: Public pages disclose unverified operator and paid-service fields instead of inventing them.

gates.label: Installable offline PWA shell
gates.evidence: Manifest, service worker, same-origin cache list and offline browser journey pass.

gates.label: PC three-column layout and browser coverage
gates.evidence: Desktop flow is tested in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit automation.

gates.label: Mobile five-tab responsive flow
gates.evidence: Today, Scan, Watchlist, Reports and More work at 390px and 360px without horizontal overflow.

gates.label: Touch and keyboard automated checks
gates.evidence: Minimum targets, focus visibility, skip link and automated accessibility checks pass.

gates.label: Performance and discoverability
gates.evidence: Public Lighthouse performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO thresholds pass.

gates.label: Public deployment and availability
gates.evidence: Public entry, app, dashboard, policies, assets and connectivity surface return valid same-origin responses.

gates.label: Synthetic and license-safe failure boundary
gates.evidence: Real data without allowed rights is blocked; synthetic labels remain next to results.

gates.label: Previous-version compatibility
gates.evidence: Old public worker compatibility and explicit non-mutating KABU LENS archive import are retained.

gates.label: One-device Android install and offline evidence
gates.evidence: SM-G996N installation, standalone launch, offline relaunch, tabs, scan and report passed; no second phone used.

gates.label: Stable links and QR
gates.evidence: PC, mobile, reports, dashboard, status, support and QR links are public.

gates.label: Repeatable CI and release checks
gates.evidence: Server, web, skeleton, quality, browser, Lighthouse and public-surface checks are repeatable.

gates.label: Manual assistive-technology journey
gates.evidence: Automated accessibility passed; a named desktop and mobile screen reader has not been manually exercised.

commercialBoundary.note: This free-launch score does not raise or replace the licensed-data commercial score.
